faq.answer: The mode of application for the Project Scientist-B (Non-Medical) posts at AIIMS Delhi is via Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Scientist-B (Non-Medical) post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India ICMR rules.
